frozen_at: 2026-09-15 after completed consumed-role V3 model-assumption audit and before any Target inference on the new candidate tail or any V4 training
status: single controlled representation test after STOP_V3_RANKING
scientific_hypothesis: A query-conditioned antisymmetric relational scorer can generalize the sparse stable critical precedence relations more jointly than a shared unary scalar score, while an exact maximum-weight total-order decoder preserves the nested-prefix representation.
what_the_audit_does_not_prove: raw local sign flips do not prove that no feasible static order exists
raw local cycles do not imply cycles in globally stable supervision
acyclic stable supervision does not by itself prove that a learned relational decoder will satisfy the fidelity contract

audit.interpretation: not a pure fresh-only generalization collapse; optimization/supervision limitations are visible on train and coexist with a modest train-to-heldout gap

preserved_invariants.target: frozen Qwen3-8B, greedy, thinking disabled, exact 4096-state lattice
preserved_invariants.nested_representation: one total order and monotone prefixes
preserved_invariants.oracle_slack_definition: extra cumulative tokens divided by active-anchor count times full-state tokens
preserved_invariants.full_fallback: independent lossless fallback; control 1.0 never forces all packets into the ranked trajectory

single_model_change.old: one shared unary scalar score per packet; pair logit equals score_i minus score_j
single_model_change.new: ordered-pair MLP over packet_i, packet_j, their difference/product, and query/global representation; antisymmetric logit z_ij = raw_ij - raw_ji
single_model_change.decoder: exact subset dynamic program maximizing the sum of decoded forward antisymmetric logits over a total order

data.new_candidate_slice: canonical target-blind QAMPARI certified ordering indices [5000,5500), disjoint from the complete parent candidate5000
data.post_exact_eligibility: maximum fidelity over any exact subset >= 0.90
data.fresh_confirmation: first 300 eligible examples in the frozen candidate-tail order; protocol fails without replacement if fewer than 300

training.within_seed_selection: minimum consumed-development example-mean worst relational boundary loss
training.across_seed_selection: minimum selected consumed-development loss, fixed before any evaluation on new confirmation

one_shot_fresh_confirmation_gate.primary: relational decoded order plus global oracle monotone cutoff
one_shot_fresh_confirmation_gate.correction: Bonferroni over all active fidelity anchors
one_shot_fresh_confirmation_gate.if_pass: freeze ranker, then separately preregister monotone cutoff
one_shot_fresh_confirmation_gate.if_fail: STOP V4 ranking; do not use calibration300 or final-test300
